attributed notation

  • CURIE: gmeow:attributedNotation
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attributedNotation
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The notation system assigned to an undeciphered or symbol-classified inscription. Non-functional: used when the inscription is not yet linked to a known language or writing system (e.g. Linear A, Rongorongo, proto-cuneiform).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:ScriptLanguageAttribution -> gmeow:InformationObject Sub-property of: gmeow:observationResult

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:attributedNotation from gmeow:ScriptLanguageAttribution to gmeow:InformationObject when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:observationResult, gmeow:ScriptLanguageAttribution, gmeow:InformationObject
